method: Event and ruler crops measured with tools/physical-stress-tests/day-swipe-motion.py. Device recording and gesture timestamps are retained privately. Only trials with attached viewport coordinates are included here; the geometry report carries incomplete attempts.

result.scope: Variable-rate XCTest screen recording. Counts are changes above one level of mean gray difference between adjacent recorded samples. The estimated drag interval excludes 120 ms at each end. This measures recorded movement, not display frame rate or input latency.
